items.brief: XRP Ledger devs propose zero-XRP wallets for stablecoin payments
items.why: Could lower onboarding friction for stablecoin accounts and AI agents without first buying XRP.

items.brief: Nearly 90% of large businesses embracing tokenized cash: DBS
items.why: Signals corporate demand for tokenized cash and stablecoins in payments.

items.brief: Moody's assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
items.why: Ratings could aid institutional adoption of tokenized stablecoin reserves.

items.brief: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain for institutional tokenization
items.why: Expands blockchain rails available for institutional tokenized assets.

items.brief: Robinhood's Tenev: US tokenization uncertainty deters serious assets
items.why: Highlights regulatory clarity as a hurdle for tokenized equities in the US.

items.brief: Intel, Oracle, IBM join objections to OKX-ICE tokenized stock plans
items.why: Objections mount as venture tests SEC framework for blockchain stock trading.

items.brief: Brazilian firms used stablecoins on election day amid currency crash
items.why: Shows stablecoins as a hedge in currency stress, relevant to tokenization demand.

items.brief: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
items.why: Adds another tokenized fund offering for non-US investors onchain.

items.brief: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing data onchain
items.why: Benchmarks could underpin tokenized index funds and portfolios.

items.brief: Hong Kong launches regulated 24/7 trading of retail tokenized MMF
items.why: First approved 24/7 retail tokenized money market fund trading.
